mapper.select: SELECT popup.popup_id, popup.popup_type, popup.title, popup.display_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_start_at, popup.display_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_end_at, popup.display_mode, popup.size_mode, popup.active_yn, popup.period_mode, popup.question_template_id, popup.updated_by, popup.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS updated_at FROM popup.popup_notice popup ORDER BY popup.updated_at DESC, popup.popup_id

SELECT popup.popup_id, popup.popup_type, popup.title, popup.display_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_start_at, popup.display_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_end_at, popup.display_mode, popup.size_mode, popup.popup_width, popup.popup_height, popup.width_ratio, popup.height_ratio, popup.minimum_width, popup.minimum_height, popup.maximum_width, popup.maximum_height, popup.show_header_yn, popup.show_close_button_yn, popup.show_footer_yn, popup.show_do_not_show_again_yn AS show_dont_show_yn, ( CASE popup.popup_type WHEN 'TEXT' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'contentTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'leftSectionBody', content.content_body ) WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'imageTitle', content.content_title, 'imageUrl', content.media_url, 'description', content.description, 'linkUrl', content.link_url ) WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'videoTitle', content.content_title, 'videoUrl', content.media_url, 'description', content.description, 'completionRatio', popup.completion_ratio, 'allowCloseBeforeCompletion', popup.allow_close_before_complete_yn = 'Y' ) WHEN 'SURVEY' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'surveyTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'passingScore', popup.passing_score, 'validateRequiredQuestions', TRUE ) WHEN 'QUIZ' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'surveyTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'passingScore', popup.passing_score, 'validateRequiredQuestions', TRUE ) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END || COALESCE(content.content_options, '{}'::JSONB) )::TEXT AS content_json, 1 AS display_order, popup.active_yn AS use_yn, popup.question_template_id, popup.period_mode, popup.repeat_interval, popup.repeat_day_of_week, popup.repeat_day_of_month, popup.hide_days, popup.completion_ratio, popup.passing_score, popup.allow_close_before_complete_yn FROM popup.popup_notice popup LEFT JOIN popup.popup_content content ON content.popup_id = popup.popup_id WHERE popup.popup_id = #{popupId}

WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS ( SELECT department_id AS ancestor_department_id, department_id AS descendant_department_id FROM popup.app_department
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.ancestor_department_id, child.department_id FROM department_tree tree JOIN popup.app_department child ON child.parent_department_id = tree.descendant_department_id ), selected_user AS ( SELECT usr.* FROM popup.app_user usr WHERE usr.employee_no = #{userId} AND usr.active_yn = 'Y' ), condition_result AS ( SELECT popup.popup_id, target.target_group_id, CASE condition.condition_type WHEN 'DEPARTMENT' THEN CASE condition.condition_operator WHEN '=' THEN CASE WHEN condition.include_child_yn = 'Y' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM department_tree tree WHERE tree.ancestor_department_id = condition.department_id AND tree.descendant_department_id = usr.department_id ) ELSE usr.department_id = condition.department_id END WHEN '!=' THEN CASE WHEN condition.include_child_yn = 'Y' THEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM department_tree tree WHERE tree.ancestor_department_id = condition.department_id AND tree.descendant_department_id = usr.department_id ) ELSE usr.department_id <> condition.department_id END ELSE FALSE END WHEN 'POSITION' THEN CASE condition.condition_operator WHEN '=' THEN usr.position_id = condition.position_id WHEN '!=' THEN usr.position_id <> condition.position_id ELSE FALSE END WHEN 'EMPLOYEE' THEN CASE condition.condition_operator WHEN '=' THEN usr.employee_no = condition.employee_no WHEN '!=' THEN usr.employee_no <> condition.employee_no ELSE FALSE END WHEN 'HIRE_DATE' THEN CASE condition.condition_operator WHEN '=' THEN usr.hire_date = condition.condition_date_value WHEN '!=' THEN usr.hire_date <> condition.condition_date_value WHEN '<' THEN usr.hire_date < condition.condition_date_value WHEN '<=' THEN usr.hire_date <= condition.condition_date_value WHEN '>' THEN usr.hire_date > condition.condition_date_value WHEN '>=' THEN usr.hire_date >= condition.condition_date_value ELSE FALSE END ELSE FALSE END AS condition_matched FROM selected_user usr CROSS JOIN popup.popup_notice popup JOIN popup.popup_target_group target ON target.popup_id = popup.popup_id JOIN popup.popup_target_condition condition ON condition.target_group_id = target.target_group_id WHERE popup.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN popup.display_start_at AND popup.display_end_at AND ( popup.question_template_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM popup.question_template template WHERE template.question_template_id = popup.question_template_id AND template.active_yn = 'Y' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM popup.user_popup_status status WHERE status.employee_no = usr.employee_no AND status.popup_id = popup.popup_id AND status.hidden_until_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ), eligible_popup AS ( SELECT popup_id FROM condition_result GROUP BY popup_id, target_group_id HAVING BOOL_AND(condition_matched) ) SELECT popup.popup_id, popup.popup_type, popup.title, popup.display_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_start_at, popup.display_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS display_end_at, CASE WHEN popup.display_mode IN ('SEQUENTIAL', 'SIMULTANEOUS') THEN popup.display_mode ELSE 'SEQUENTIAL' END AS display_mode, popup.size_mode, popup.popup_width, popup.popup_height, popup.width_ratio, popup.height_ratio, popup.minimum_width, popup.minimum_height, popup.maximum_width, popup.maximum_height, popup.show_header_yn, popup.show_close_button_yn, popup.show_footer_yn, popup.show_do_not_show_again_yn AS show_dont_show_yn, ( CASE popup.popup_type WHEN 'TEXT' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'contentTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'leftSectionBody', content.content_body ) WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'imageTitle', content.content_title, 'imageUrl', content.media_url, 'description', content.description, 'linkUrl', content.link_url ) WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'videoTitle', content.content_title, 'videoUrl', content.media_url, 'description', content.description, 'completionRatio', popup.completion_ratio, 'allowCloseBeforeCompletion', popup.allow_close_before_complete_yn = 'Y' ) WHEN 'SURVEY' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'surveyTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'passingScore', popup.passing_score, 'validateRequiredQuestions', TRUE ) WHEN 'QUIZ' THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT( 'surveyTitle', content.content_title, 'description', content.description, 'passingScore', popup.passing_score, 'validateRequiredQuestions', TRUE ) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END || COALESCE(content.content_options, '{}'::JSONB) )::TEXT AS content_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY popup.popup_id)::INTEGER AS display_order, popup.active_yn AS use_yn, popup.question_template_id, popup.period_mode, popup.repeat_interval, popup.repeat_day_of_week, popup.repeat_day_of_month, popup.hide_days, popup.completion_ratio, popup.passing_score, popup.allow_close_before_complete_yn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT popup_id FROM eligible_popup ) eligible JOIN popup.popup_notice popup ON popup.popup_id = eligible.popup_id LEFT JOIN popup.popup_content content ON content.popup_id = popup.popup_id ORDER BY popup.popup_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup.user_popup_status ( employee_no, popup_id, popup_status, display_count, hidden_from_at, hidden_until_at, completed_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{popupId}, 'HIDDEN', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{hideDays} * INTERVAL '1 day'), 'N', #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (employee_no, popup_id) DO UPDATE SET popup_status = 'HIDDEN', hidden_from_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, hidden_until_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{hideDays} * INTERVAL '1 day'), updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT notice.popup_id AS popupId, notice.popup_type AS popupType, notice.question_template_id AS questionTemplateId, notice.passing_score AS passingScore FROM popup.popup_notice notice JOIN popup.app_user usr ON usr.employee_no = #{userId} AND usr.active_yn = 'Y' WHERE notice.popup_id = #{popupId} AND notice.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN notice.display_start_at AND notice.display_end_at

INSERT INTO popup.popup_response ( client_request_id, popup_id, employee_no, question_template_id, response_status, response_started_at, submitted_at, received_at, total_score, passed_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{clientRequestId}, #{popupId}, #{userId}, #{questionTemplateId}, 'SUBMITTED', #{responseStartedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{totalScore}, #{passedYn}, #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (employee_no, popup_id) DO UPDATE SET client_request_id = EXCLUDED.client_request_id, question_template_id = EXCLUDED.question_template_id, response_status = 'SUBMITTED', response_started_at = EXCLUDED.response_started_at, submitted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, received_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, total_score = EXCLUDED.total_score, passed_yn = EXCLUDED.passed_yn, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING response_id

INSERT INTO popup.popup_response_answer ( response_id, question_id, text_answer, earned_score, correct_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{responseId}, #{questionId}, #{textAnswer}, #{earnedScore}, #{correctYn}, #{userId}, #{userId} ) RETURNING response_answer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup.user_popup_status AS current_status ( employee_no, popup_id, popup_status, display_count, completed_yn, completed_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{popupId}, CASE WHEN #{passedYn} = 'Y' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'SUBMITTED' END, 0, #{passedYn}, CASE WHEN #{passedYn} = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (employee_no, popup_id) DO UPDATE SET popup_status = CASE WHEN current_status.completed_yn = 'Y' OR #{passedYn} = 'Y' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'SUBMITTED' END, completed_yn = CASE WHEN current_status.completed_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE #{passedYn} END, completed_at = CASE WHEN current_status.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN current_status.completed_at WHEN #{passedYn} = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT notice.popup_id AS popupId, notice.popup_type AS popupType, notice.completion_ratio AS completionRatio FROM popup.popup_notice notice JOIN popup.app_user usr ON usr.employee_no = #{userId} AND usr.active_yn = 'Y' WHERE notice.popup_id = #{popupId} AND notice.popup_type = 'VIDEO' AND notice.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN notice.display_start_at AND notice.display_end_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup.video_view_status AS current_view ( employee_no, popup_id, total_duration_seconds, last_position_seconds, maximum_position_seconds, watched_seconds, watched_ratio, completed_yn, first_played_at, last_played_at, completed_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{popupId}, #{durationSeconds}, #{positionSeconds}, #{maximumPositionSeconds}, #{watchedSeconds}, #{watchedRatio}, #{completedYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CASE WHEN #{completedYn} = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (employee_no, popup_id) DO UPDATE SET total_duration_seconds = EXCLUDED.total_duration_seconds, last_position_seconds = EXCLUDED.last_position_seconds, maximum_position_seconds = GREATEST( current_view.maximum_position_seconds, EXCLUDED.maximum_position_seconds ), watched_seconds = GREATEST( current_view.watched_seconds, EXCLUDED.watched_seconds ), watched_ratio = GREATEST( current_view.watched_ratio, EXCLUDED.watched_ratio ), completed_yn = CASE WHEN current_view.completed_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE EXCLUDED.completed_yn END, last_played_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CASE WHEN current_view.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN current_view.completed_at WHEN EXCLUDED.completed_yn = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM popup.app_user usr CROSS JOIN popup.popup_notice notice WHERE usr.employee_no = #{userId} AND usr.active_yn = 'Y' AND notice.popup_id = #{popupId} AND notice.active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup.user_popup_status AS current_status ( employee_no, popup_id, popup_status, first_displayed_at, last_displayed_at, display_count, closed_at, completed_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{popupId}, #{eventType}, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'CLOSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, 'N', #{userId}, #{userId} ) ON CONFLICT (employee_no, popup_id) DO UPDATE SET popup_status = CASE WHEN current_status.completed_yn = 'Y' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN #{eventType} = 'CLOSED' THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'DISPLAYED' END, first_displayed_at = CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN COALESCE( current_status.first_displayed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE current_status.first_displayed_at END, last_displayed_at = CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE current_status.last_displayed_at END, display_count = current_status.display_count + CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'DISPLAYED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{eventType} = 'CLOSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE current_status.closed_at END, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT status.employee_no AS userId, status.popup_id AS popupId, status.popup_status AS popupStatus, status.first_displayed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS firstDisplayedAt, status.last_displayed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS lastDisplayedAt, status.display_count AS displayCount, status.closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS closedAt, status.hidden_until_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS hiddenUntilAt, (status.completed_yn = 'Y') AS completed, status.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS completedAt FROM popup.user_popup_status status WHERE status.employee_no = #{userId} ORDER BY status.popup_id
